= Deploying the Agent

The relay agent forwards jobs from an isolated network segment to the Driftbeam service.

== Running under systemd

Install the unit file, then enable the service so the relay survives reboots.

[source,ini]
----
[Unit]
Description=Driftbeam relay agent

[Service]
ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/driftbeam-relay --profile production
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=5

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
----

== Container health checks

The container image exposes a health endpoint on the admin port; wire it into your orchestrator.

[source,bash]
----
curl --fail --max-time 3 http://localhost:9631/healthz
----

== Resource limits

Set memory ceilings explicitly; the relay buffers bursts in memory before spilling to disk.

[source,yaml]
----
resources:
  limits:
    memory: 512Mi
  requests:
    memory: 128Mi
----
